sentences.text: Në verë Ardi nuk shkon në shkollë.
sentences.english: In summer Ardi does not go to school.

sentences.text: Ai shkon te gjyshi çdo ditë.
sentences.english: He goes to his grandfather every day.
The grandfather lives in the village.

sentences.text: Shtëpia e gjyshit është e vjetër, por e bukur.
sentences.english: The grandfather's house is old, but beautiful.

sentences.text: Gjyshi i jep Ardit bukë dhe çaj.
sentences.english: The grandfather gives Ardi bread and tea.

sentences.text: Ardi ha bukë dhe pi çaj.
sentences.english: Ardi eats bread and drinks tea.
The grandfather drinks coffee and reads.
In the house there are many books.

sentences.text: Ardit i pëlqen shumë vera në shtëpinë e gjyshit.
sentences.english: Ardi likes the summer at his grandfather's house very much.
